stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 reset [--soft|--mixed|--hard] [<target>] [--] [<pathspec>...]

Reset the current HEAD, index, or working tree to a target state.

When pathspecs are provided, only index entries are reset and an explicit
target must be supplied, for example: git2 reset HEAD -- <path>...

Options:
    --soft
        move HEAD only
    --mixed
        reset HEAD and index (default)
    --hard
        reset HEAD, index, and working tree
    <target>
        commit, tag, or other revision to reset to
    <pathspec>...
        paths to reset in the index (requires explicit target)
